name: Cuckoo
summary: Single-card avoidance game where players pass low cards to neighbors and lowest card loses a life.
rules_text: Each player gets a life counter (e.g. 3 chips). Use a standard 52-card deck ignoring suits, Ace low, King high. Each round deal one card face down to each active player. Starting left of dealer, each player in turn looks at own card and may keep it or force a swap with the next player to the left. That next player cannot refuse except if they hold King, then swap is blocked and turn ends. King is stop card. Play proceeds clockwise around circle. Dealer plays last and may swap with top of undealt stock, not with first player, unless King blocks. After all turns, all cards are revealed. Player(s) with lowest rank loses one life. If tied, all tied lose a life. Players with no lives are out. Shuffle and deal next round with remaining players. Winner is last player remaining.
rating_reason: Single-card swap, hidden info, elimination, bluffing, fits engine
